terminal.emulator: fresh direct PTY with deterministic loopback HTTP/SSE and synthetic xclip

reference.capture: Hades setup sidecar followed by configured surface, history restart, and clipboard re-entry replays

normalization: Binary paths, synthetic HOME/HERMES_HOME paths, PTY paths, timestamps, session identifiers, raw redraw bytes, and ephemeral server ports are omitted or represented by stable markers.

The local server accepts only loopback OpenAI-compatible requests and records normalized request paths, models, stream flags, and deterministic prompt markers; no credentials or external network are used.

Slash completion, model picker, sessions overlay, history, and clipboard are observed only at their bounded configured seams; no claim is made about unobserved provider catalogs, session switching, or remote clipboard behavior.
Synthetic xclip is placed first on an isolated child PATH and the host clipboard, Hermes config.yaml, API keys, OAuth, and provider installers remain outside the replay.

steps.precondition: hades setup --local has written only the Hades local-provider sidecar; a fresh 120x40 process reaches the ready composer.
The same configured process has closed its overlays and the deterministic local stream is ready for another prompt.
A fresh configured process loads the same sidecar and .hermes_history; an isolated synthetic xclip is available to that process.

unknowns: Exact Hermes provider selection persistence, session switching/resumption, provider errors, remote OSC52 clipboard behavior, and non-loopback networking remain outside this configured local journey.
The replay proves behavior at stable state and request boundaries; sparse terminal redraw fragments are not treated as independent product semantics.
